passageOverrides.before: Acquire and retain the existing installation fence with native root provenance and pre/post custody checks; distinguish busy from missing or invalid state.
passageOverrides.after: Define the held-fence view that installation captures borrow (law 458c item 8): the held I, the actor, a charged recheck of the held fence and a sample of the fence carrier's filesystem, and the carrier name lifecycle.fence. The read session implements it for every production reader. The supplied and native installation fences (one nonblocking exclusive attempt with native root provenance and pre/post custody checks, busy distinguished from missing or invalid state) remain for supplied-root tests only; no production installation reader calls them. No descriptor escape, creation or authority.

passageOverrides.before: The read side's observation path (law 458c r5 items 5, 6, 7 and 11). One session per process on one failure-latching ledger with the owner's limits; one observation per session. It reaches I through the durable write gate's own step 0 and step 1 code, shared rather than copied, with no barrier: a charged, retained, no-follow walk from the root to I under the read receipt's sealed lending, a positive absence only when the first missing suffix component is observed absent under its retained parent, and lifecycle.fence opened through the retained I. The lock wait repeats one nonblocking attempt on that same descriptor, paced at 25 ms, for at most 5 s and 201 attempts, all reserved before the first; busy retries, any other failure stops on the host I/O row, and a lock still busy at the bound is the busy row. Under the held fence it runs the receipt's rechecks and the full recheck set, reads the required members charged before they run (the fixed members up front, each lineage node before its own read), records missing, undecodable or misbound members as structural findings, and runs the same full recheck over every captured file, also after a failed read. Every refusal takes exactly the write gate's row. Never a write capability. Library only: no consumer uses it yet.

passageOverrides.before: Provisional observations under a native installation fence. No selected store, core/profile admission, current authority, durability or creation permission. Cooperative first-party exclusion and the existing kernel/loader TCB apply.
passageOverrides.after: The production installation reader API (law 458c r5 items 5 and 8). InstallationReadFence::acquire produces the read receipt, runs the observation session on the account's I and requires I complete; every refusal is its law 468 item 6 row, and a development build ends at CORE.NO_EMBEDDED_RELEASE. A bounded leaf or descendant capture opens only through the held I by the read session, is charged to its one ledger, and rechecks the held fence, every retained edge and the file before its bytes are consumed; a request refused before any native step (an invalid leaf, depth or bound) has no row. Provisional observations only: no selected store, core/profile admission, current authority, durability or creation permission. Cooperative first-party exclusion and the existing kernel/loader TCB apply.
